entry.summary:
The 2025 theme for Solomon Islands Language Week is ‘Protektim langguis an kalsa blong yumi – Protect our language and culture’.

To celebrate this year, Selwyn Teho, Vice President of the Wellington Solomon Island community in New Zealand, talks about what Solomon Aelan Pijin Langguis Wik means to him.
